strings: m_c complains to r_c0 about how even waking up seems to be a struggle for {PRONOUN/m_c/object} now.
m_c buries {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head into the nesting around {PRONOUN/m_c/object} - now {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nightmares seem to be following {PRONOUN/m_c/object} into the waking hours.
Monsters seem to lurk around the camp, waiting for m_c to wake from the small snatches of sleep {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} manage to get.
While trying to talk to the night guards and bite away the boredom, m_c fell asleep, unable to move.
